map.根据皮疹分布、口腔病变及神经系统/呼吸系统表现，评估手足口病严重程度与隔离期限: Assess HFMD severity and isolation period from rash distribution, oral lesions and neuro/respiratory signs
map.住院观察，降颅压: Admit for observation, reduce intracranial pressure
map.提示：手足口病由肠道病毒(EV71/CoxA16等)引起，5岁以下高发。EV71: Note: HFMD is caused by enteroviruses (EV71/CoxA16 etc.), most common under 5 years. EV71 infection tends to be severe. Days 1-4 are the key progression window; monitor warning signs closely. Isolation: 1 week after symptoms resolve (usually 2 weeks total). Non-itchy/painless rash needs no treatment; painful oral ulcers affecting feeding can use topical medication. EV71 vaccine effectively prevents severe disease. This tool is for clinical reference only.
map.手足口+臀疹≥2 处、口腔疹→典型 HFMD，第 2 天出疹高峰，对症即可。: HFMD + buttock rash ≥2 sites, oral rash -> typical HFMD, day-2 rash peak, symptomatic care suffices.
map.持续高热、惊跳、肢体抖、呼吸心率快→警惕重症(脑炎/肺水肿)，立即就医。: Persistent high fever, startle, limb tremor, fast breathing/heart rate -> suspect severe (encephalitis/pulmonary edema), seek care immediately.
map.症状消失后约 1 周，通常发病 14 天内具传染性。: About 1 week after symptoms resolve; usually infectious within 14 days of onset.
map.出现神经或心肺症状属重症，需 ICU 监护。: Neuro or cardiorespiratory symptoms mean severe disease, need ICU monitoring.

map.手足口病(皮疹口腔)病程评估器，根据皮疹分布、口腔病变及全身症状评估病情严重程度: The HFMD (rash/oral) course assessor evaluates severity and isolation period from rash distribution, oral lesions and systemic symptoms. A medical professional tool based on authoritative standards, for reference only.
